description: App image updates (sdk/contracts/poc-v0.md §10.2): Renovate's kubernetes manager bumps tag + digest in apps/<id>/manifests/*.yaml, and ci-apps.yml re-runs the §9.4 gate on every PR.
Only patch and digest bumps of verified apps whose manifest says spec.updates.automerge: patch merge automatically when green; minor and major bumps wait for a human.
Renovate cannot read the manifests, so sdk/tools/validate-apps fails if the automerge list below differs from the verified apps with automerge: patch.

packageRules.description: Every app image: one PR per image and update type (the default branch name carries the image), so the gate runs per app.
Minor and major versions need a person (§10.2).
onemind automerge: verified apps with spec.updates.automerge: patch (kept in sync by sdk/tools/validate-apps).

Database sidecars: no major PostgreSQL or MariaDB bumps. A new major cannot open the old data directory (PostgreSQL refuses to start; PostgreSQL 18+ images start an empty cluster in a new versioned folder), and the CI smoke test installs on a fresh volume, so it stays green. A major move needs a dump and restore, as its own change.
